findings.summary: The entry's own auto-seed produces a board that can never reach a non-null termination.state, so criterion 8 / Z1 (runs to terminal state, exits 0) is unreachable by construction — the fourth same-shape recurrence. bin/e0-regression.sh:170 seeds with exactly one clue and passes no --source: `node scripts/e0-seed.mjs ... --clue "$RESEARCH_QUESTION"`, and scripts/e0-seed.mjs:80 forwards only `--clue` pairs to `tick-entry --seed`, so parseSeedCliArgs returns sources=[] (src/tick-seed.ts:96,126) and runSeed publishes the clue with `sources: []` (src/tick-seed.ts:54,62; asserted by test/g4e-seed.test.ts:79-87). On tick 1 that card is status=open with sources=[], so decideTick takes the block branch: isWebSource([]) is false, isValidSources([]) is vacuously true (`[].every(...)` === true, src/tick.ts:209), and roleForSources([]) returns null (src/tick.ts:58-64, empty loop) ⇒ `{kind:"block", reason:"unmapped_source"}` (src/tick.ts:277-285). runWrite CASes it to blocked (src/tick-run.ts:799-814), which is a real bus write, so Z1's head_seq growth passes. But blocked is terminal (src/tick.ts:167-169, PENDING_CLUE_STATUSES), no clue is published (cluesPublished=0), so hasPendingWork(postWriteState)||0>0 is false (src/tick-run.ts:1684) and tick.md:92 skips the continuation put ⇒ drain ends with rounds=1 and no tick 2. On that single tick decideTermination gets prevZeroGrowthRounds=0 (first tick, no --prev-* passed), coverage 0 === prevCoverage 0 ⇒ zeroGrowthRounds=1, which is < zeroGrowthThreshold 2 (src/tick.ts:88,362-363,384) and capHit is false (1 card < maxClues 64, depth 0 < maxDepth 3) ⇒ state=null. scripts/e0-terminal-state.mjs then prints the literal "null", bin/e0-verify.sh:72-74 sets FAIL TERMINAL and exits 3, and bin/e0-regression.sh:218,235 returns 3 on a run that did everything the entry asked of it. Reaching zeroGrowthRounds>=2 requires at least two ticks, but the seeded board terminalizes on tick 1 and therefore never continues.

No test exercises the entry's real seed-then-terminate path, so the unreachable-Z1 defect above is invisible to the suite — the same 'mock all-green ≠ runs on real machine' shape §1.3/§4 exist to prevent. Every terminal-state assertion in test/e0-regression.test.ts feeds bin/e0-verify.sh a hand-chosen termination.state via makeEngineRoot(dir, drainId, termState) (test/e0-regression.test.ts:189-240, 258-296): the discriminating cases pass termState:null and the passing cases pass "converged" (lines 652-691). T-VERIFY-DRAIN (lines 711-838) does drive the real bin/deep-research-loop.sh, but it stubs LOOP_ENGINE_CLI with a fake `console.log(drainJson)` (line 747) and hand-writes a journal.jsonl whose run_output carries `state: "converged"`, `zeroGrowthRounds: 2` (lines 771-793) — values the real single-tick seeded run cannot produce (see prior finding). T-SEED (lines 597-642) verifies seeding and idempotency against the fake bus but never runs a tick or reads termination. Consequently no test would fail if termination.state were structurally pinned at null for every real run of the entry, which is precisely the acceptance-criterion-8 arm the package exists to make true.

The auto-seed's clue text is the research question itself, not a source-tagged research clue, which makes the seeded card structurally undispatchable rather than merely unlucky. bin/e0-regression.sh:170 passes `--clue "$RESEARCH_QUESTION"` (profiles/deploy/e0-regression.env:18 sets it to the literal string 'e0 regression baseline'), so the one card on the board carries no sources and cannot map to any worker role, while the profile does configure ALLOWED_ROOT=/data/code/self/agent-runtime (line 25) for exactly the code-local worker that a `sources: ["code-local"]` seed would dispatch to. src/tick-seed.ts already supports `--source` (line 108) and tick-entry documents it (src/tick-entry.ts:43), but scripts/e0-seed.mjs neither accepts nor forwards it (scripts/e0-seed.mjs:34-43, 80). As written, the seeded run can only ever produce one block CAS, so the harvest/coverage path the loop exists to exercise is never reached on the regression bus.

Spec §1.1 and §1.2 are correctly satisfied and the two rejected E0a root causes are genuinely fixed. scripts/e0-metrics.mjs reads head_seq only from GET /v1/channels and locates the channel by channel_id (lines 33-58, 109-117), never touching GET /v1/channels/<id> for head_seq; a read-miss fails loudly naming the channel and its actual field set rather than degrading to 0 (lines 83-98). sumHeadSeqs is a true full sum over all channels (lines 61-68), and test/e0-metrics.test.ts:18-33 kills the greedy-sed implementation with the spec's own 9999/8888 witness. bin/e0-verify.sh reads every JSON value through node JSON.parse (lines 40-47), and test/fixtures/fake-bus.mjs matches the real contract — single-channel GET omits head_seq (lines 97-111), list GET includes it (lines 59-77) — with T-FIXTURE-CONTRACT asserting both directions (test/e0-regression.test.ts:534-556). No token values appear anywhere in the repo, only token file paths.
